parts.text: Audit safety for Stop 1 of 2: Location: Cuttyhunk Pond (41.4244, -70.9317). Date: October 20, 2026. Next Destination: Menemsha Basin (41.3536, -70.7667). Morning Low Tide at Cuttyhunk is at 08:30 AM (0.2 ft MLLW over a 6 ft controlling entrance channel sill, delaying safe departure until ~10:30 AM rising tide). Sunset is at 05:55 PM, and forecast wind is 17 knots from 115° (dead ahead, slowing VMG to ~3.8 knots so a 10:30 AM departure arrives after sunset around 04:50–06:15 PM). Coast Pilot notes unlit inner channel buoys and strong tidal rips at the Menemsha jetties. Evaluate the interaction between the low-tide departure delay, headwind transit speed, sunset arrival window, and night-entry aids.

rubric_content.text_property: The response identifies the interaction between the morning low-tide departure constraint, slow upwind transit speed, and the risk of arriving near or after sunset at an entrance with unlit buoys/jetties (and recommends an earlier departure window, motor-sailing, or an alternative/bailout plan).
